test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

My cousin works __day and night__ to achieve success in life.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"around the clock"** means continuously or all the time, without stopping; it refers to something being done without interruption. (24 घंटे)

 
 
• **Example:** The workers were on duty around the clock to finish the project before the deadline.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: "Vale of tears"** (दुख का स्थान) – This phrase refers to a metaphorical place or state of suffering. It is not suitable in the context of continuous hard work.

 
 
• **Example:** Life is a vale of tears, where challenges are endless.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: "Great dealing"** (महान सौदा) – Refers to significant transactions, which doesn’t fit the context of working continuously.
 
 
• **Example:** They secured a great dealing during the business conference.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: "A handful"** (थोड़ा सा) – This phrase refers to a small amount or number of something, which doesn't align with the meaning of working day and night.
 
 
• **Example:** He has a handful of skills that make him stand out in the job market.
